lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，骨节咔嚓作响。
腐尸的移动让空气更冷。
lines.en: The movement makes the air colder.

lines.zh: 啃咬地面，寻找存活的迹象。
我拖着一条腿，蹭过碎玻璃。
lines.en: I drag one leg over broken glass.

lines.zh: 尘土从我的伤口里漏出来。
lines.en: Dust spills out of my wounds.

lines.zh: 我扶着断墙一点一点走。
lines.en: I hold the broken wall and inch along.
My joints bend backward; I still walk.

lines.zh: 腐尸的视线在荒野中游移。

lines.en: Stare at you, seeking an opportunity.

lines.zh: 眼窝空空的，我却看得见。
lines.en: My sockets are empty, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 我顺着你留下的汗味走。
lines.en: I follow the sweat trail you left.

lines.zh: 我数着你手里的火把晃几下。
lines.en: I count each sway of your torch.
Turn your back and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，朝你的呼吸走。
lines.en: Step by step, I walk toward your breathing.
Stare at you, ready to act.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不愈合，得吃东西。
lines.en: My wound will not close; I need to eat.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的胳膊。

lines.en: Rotting flesh sloughs from the tear.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖反折，站不直了。
lines.en: My knee bends backward; I can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 我的骨头早断了，也不差这一刀。
lines.en: My bones broke long ago; one more cut is nothing.
My blood dried out long ago.
Enjoy the taste of decayed flesh!
The essence of decay, my craving!
Avoid the wheels, I have no escape!
I collide with a tank, broken!
The scent of a compatriot, come!
The touch of a compatriot, warmth!
The embrace of a compatriot, comfort!
The touch of a compatriot, solace!
Your blood is useless to me.

lines.zh: 蛆虫在我的身体里爬行。
别动，你很快会变成这样。
lines.en: Don't move, you'll soon be like me.

lines.zh: 你退后的脚步踩响了碎石。
你的呼吸喷在我脸上，太近。
lines.en: Your breath on my face — far too close.

lines.zh: 你的门闩挡不住我的指甲。
lines.en: Your door bolt won't stop my nails.

lines.zh: 你翻箱子的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear you rifling through that crate.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里还卡着上一顿。
lines.en: The last meal is still stuck between my teeth.
The corner is blocked — only me.

lines.zh: 你的气味粘在我喉咙里。
lines.en: Your scent sticks in my throat.
Someone opened a crate behind the wall.
The wind carries the smell of the living.
I stop and listen for three seconds.

lines.zh: 那个影子不是我的同类。
lines.en: That shape is not one of mine.

lines.zh: 我的下颚自己动起来了。
lines.en: My jaw moves on its own.
Come closer, I'll make you suffer.
That door behind you is locked.
I won't make it easy for you.
I hug the wall and go around.

lines.zh: 铁皮一动，我就知道方向。
lines.en: A tin sheet moves and I know where.
I crush a glass bottle underfoot.
You have backed into a corner.
My breath rasps like a broken bellows.
Pain means nothing; I am inside.
I shove the plank door aside.
You count steps; so do I.
Only a hiss left in my throat.
Bite bite bite, your blood tastes good!
Huff huff huff, breathe my venom!

lines.zh: 喉咙烂了，只能这样出声。
lines.en: My throat is rotted — this is all the voice I have.
Huff, rot you to the core!

lines.zh: 呼呼呼，你离死亡更近了！
lines.en: Huff huff huff, you're closer to death!

lines.zh: 腐烂的手掐住你的喉咙。
lines.en: A rotting hand clamps your throat.
I bite your shoulder; the blood is sweet.

lines.zh: 指甲一片片留在你身上。
lines.en: My nails stay in your skin, one by one.

lines.zh: 这一口咬得我牙都酸了。
lines.en: This bite makes even my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 巷子深处，我们的脚步在合拢。
lines.en: Deep in the alley, our footsteps converge.

lines.zh: 我从塌了一半的楼里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a half-collapsed building.
The soil gave way. I'm out.

lines.zh: 我从一辆翻倒的车下爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out from a flipped truck.

lines.zh: 嘴里还含着昨夜的泥土。
lines.en: Last night's soil is still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 皮肤下面什么也没有了。
lines.en: There is nothing left under my skin.

lines.zh: 肋骨断了两根，我照样爬。
lines.en: Two ribs snap, yet I still crawl.
Water in my lungs — I stopped feeling long ago.

lines.zh: 气浪掀走了我半边肩膀。
lines.en: The blast tears away half my shoulder.

lines.zh: 箭从胸口穿出，我照样走。
lines.en: The arrow exits my chest; I keep walking.
Nothing but acid remains in my stomach.
